open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have app {a b c d : List Expression.Ident} (h : a.Subset c) (h' : b.Subset d) :
      (a ++ b).Subset (c ++ d) :=
    fun _ hm => List.mem_append.mpr ((List.mem_append.mp hm).imp (@h _) (@h' _))
  intro Hnorm
  induction Hnorm <;>
    try solve | exact List.Subset.empty | ((repeat' apply app) <;> assumption)
  case app H1 H2 Hn ih1 ih2 =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · exact fun _ h => h
    · next Hfalse =>
      have h := Hn IsOldPred.oldPred
      cases h
      exfalso
      apply Hfalse
      rfl
    · exact app ih1 ih2
